verses.english: “Mendicants, these five fatal wounds lead to a place of loss, to hell.

verses.pali: Mātā jīvitā voropitā hoti, pitā jīvitā voropito hoti, arahaṁ jīvitā voropito hoti, tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṁ uppāditaṁ hoti, saṅgho bhinno hoti.
verses.english: Murdering your mother or father or a perfected one; maliciously shedding the blood of a Realized One; and causing a schism in the Saṅgha.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca āpāyikā nerayikā parikuppā atekicchā”ti.
verses.english: These five fatal wounds lead to a place of loss, to hell.”
